brief: {name} is an app and web development company. We built its website: a homepage with a quote form, a build-day estimator tool and a showcase of past builds.
The homepage puts the quote form beside the headline, and the estimator lets a visitor size a project before they talk to anyone. A LinkedIn ad and a Google search listing point at the same site.

showcases.title: Build-day estimator and work showcase
showcases.text: The estimator takes a project type and feature list. The work section groups past builds by kind.

showcases.title: A LinkedIn ad and a Google search listing
showcases.text: Both carry the same message as the homepage headline.
